messages.content: I have the Saturday address now: 4209 Lassiter Mill Road. Before we leave the Hampton reservation in place, compare its full two-night cost with the less expensive Midtown option, including parking, and factor in the driving for Saturday and Sunday.

I’ll compare both for Friday, November 14 through Sunday, November 16, for one room and two adults. The booked Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh Midtown is $352.00 for two nights plus $46.11 in taxes, with parking included, for a total of $398.11. The Midtown Lodge quote is $298.00 for two nights plus $39.04 in taxes and $18.00 per night for parking, bringing its comparable total to $373.04.
So the actual difference is only about twenty-five dollars?
Yes. Hampton costs $25.07 more for the stay once the Midtown Lodge parking charge is included. That is about $12.54 more per night on a two-night comparison.
How do the drives compare from each hotel to Lassiter Mill Road on Saturday?

Under ordinary Saturday traffic, Hampton is approximately 10 to 15 minutes from 4209 Lassiter Mill Road. Midtown Lodge is approximately 22 to 30 minutes away. Traffic around North Hills can vary, but Hampton should save roughly 12 to 15 minutes each way for the gathering.
And Sunday? We’re having lunch downtown, then leaving around 3:45 for Atlanta.

Hampton is about 10 to 15 minutes from central downtown Raleigh, while Midtown Lodge is about 6 to 10 minutes away. The Midtown Lodge has a modest advantage before lunch, but after lunch your Atlanta drive begins from downtown either way, so the hotel location does not materially change the return trip.
Remind me of the cancellation terms and whether both will accept us arriving between 12:30 and 1:00 Saturday morning.

Hampton permits free cancellation until 6:00 p.m. local time on Thursday, November 13, and your existing reservation is guaranteed for late arrival with the 12:30 to 1:00 a.m. note attached. Midtown Lodge accepts late arrival if the room is guaranteed, but its quoted refundable rate must be canceled by 6:00 p.m. Wednesday, November 12.
What are their customer ratings? I want to be sure the cheaper one is not a major step down.

Google currently shows Hampton at 4.4 out of 5 and Midtown Lodge at 3.8 out of 5. Those are customer-review ratings, not hotel class ratings. Hampton is the stronger-reviewed property as well as the closer one for Saturday.
For this Raleigh visit only, I’m willing to go below 4.0 if the savings and logistics justify it. I don’t want that treated as a change for other hotel searches.

Understood. For this trip alone, the 3.8 rating does not remove Midtown Lodge from consideration. Even so, its $25.07 savings comes with paid parking, a longer Saturday round trip, a lower customer rating, and a cancellation deadline one day earlier.
That is not enough savings. Keep the Hampton for one room for my wife and me, and make sure nothing about the late arrival or cancellation deadline has changed.

The Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh Midtown reservation remains active for one room and two adults, checking in Friday, November 14 and checking out Sunday, November 16. The total remains $398.11, including taxes and parking, under confirmation RHM-731946. Free cancellation still ends at 6:00 p.m. local time Thursday, November 13, and the guaranteed late-arrival note still states 12:30 to 1:00 a.m. Saturday. No Midtown Lodge reservation was made.
